events.details: A torch procession leaves for Reumannhof at 17:00, followed by a magic show. Activities are aimed especially at families.
events.admission: Free entry. The listing does not state whether every activity is free.
events.language: Programme language not specified; expect local German-language activities.

events.subtitle: An autumn escape above Vienna
events.description: A pumpkin market, seasonal food and kite-making on the edge of the Vienna Woods.

events.admission: Free entry. Food, purchases and optional activities may cost extra.
events.language: No performance language specified; a market and outdoor festival.
